name: newsgenie
description: SaaS customer portal for news publishers with an agentic AI assistant (React + Express + SQLite + Claude).

scripts.dev: concurrently --names api,web --prefix-colors blue,green "npm run dev -w backend" "npm run dev -w frontend"
scripts.test: npm test -w backend && npm test -w frontend
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w backend && npm run typecheck -w frontend
